home.heroTitle: Ghar Ke Har Kaam Ka Jugnu
home.heroSubtitle: Connect directly with verified electricians, plumbers, AC technicians & salon experts in Muzaffarnagar. Transparent rates, zero middleman commission, same-day arrival.
home.step1Desc: Select the trade you need and choose your locality or pincode in Muzaffarnagar.
home.step2Desc: Inspect experience, service coverage, real customer ratings, and availability.
home.step3Desc: Pick your preferred date, time, and address. The worker receives an immediate SMS notification.
home.step4Desc: Directly coordinate over phone or WhatsApp. Rate and review your worker after service completion.
home.heroBadge: ✨ Jugnu • Verified Local Experts In Muzaffarnagar
home.problemBadge: The Old Way vs. The Jugnu Way
home.problemTitle: Tired of the Daily Hassle of Home Repairs?
home.problemSubtitle: Finding reliable help in Muzaffarnagar shouldn't mean endless follow-up calls, contractor markups, or unvetted strangers.
home.problemOldSub: Calling random numbers or roadside contractors
home.problem1OldDesc: Middlemen inflate the bills while underpaying the hardworking artisan.
home.problem1NewDesc: Artisans keep 100% of their earnings. You pay transparent, fair local rates.
home.problem2OldDesc: Repeated promises to arrive, but days pass with endless waiting and no response.
home.problem2NewDesc: Prompt, dependable arrival with direct WhatsApp & phone coordination across PIN 251001 & 251002.
home.problem3OldDesc: Zero identity checks for individuals entering your family home.
home.problem3NewDesc: Every artisan is physically vetted and government-ID verified before approval.
home.reviewGuaranteeSubtitle: We strictly reject fabricated reviews. Every rating on Jugnu comes solely from residents who booked and completed an authentic service.
home.reviewPillar1Desc: Only customers whose booking was completed via a secure OTP can rate an artisan.
home.reviewPillar2Desc: No fake reviews, no bought stars. Genuine customer feedback ensures high quality and accountability.
home.reviewPillar3Desc: Artisans maintaining low ratings or receiving safety complaints are promptly delisted by our admin team.
home.servicesSubtitle: Browse skilled professionals available for same-day and scheduled service in Muzaffarnagar
home.whySubtitle: Building a secure, transparent, and fair service ecosystem for both residents and local artisans
home.whyPillar1Desc: Every artisan's government Aadhaar or Voter ID is manually inspected and approved by platform administrators.
home.whyPillar2Desc: Call or chat on WhatsApp directly with the worker once a booking is placed. No call centers or confusing intermediaries.
home.whyPillar3Desc: Enjoy zero platform fees and 0% commission for the starting 3 months. Artisans keep 100% of their earnings with transparent pricing.
home.whyPillar4Desc: Built specifically for Muzaffarnagar city, New Mandi, Civil Lines, and surrounding tehsil areas.
home.howSubtitle: Simple, direct, and transparent steps to hire trusted local artisans in Muzaffarnagar
home.howStep1Desc: Select the trade you need—Electrician, Plumber, AC Repair, Cleaning or Salon—and choose your locality (251001 or 251002).
home.howStep2Desc: Check verified government ID badges, years of local experience, and honest customer ratings before booking.
home.howStep3Desc: Book your preferred date and time. Coordinate directly with your artisan on phone or WhatsApp without call center delays.
home.howStep4Desc: Pay your artisan directly upon job completion at transparent local rates. 0% platform commission for the first 3 months.
